name: @temples/ssr
description: Server-side rendering and static site generation for the Temples template engine, wired to linkedom.

scripts.build: bun build src/ssr.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --packages external --tsconfig-override tsconfig.build.json --external @temples/engine --external @temples/components --entry-naming "[name].[ext]" && bun build src/ssr.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --packages external --tsconfig-override tsconfig.build.json --external @temples/engine --external @temples/components --minify --entry-naming "[name].min.[ext]" && bun build src/ssr.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target node --packages external --tsconfig-override tsconfig.build.json --external @temples/engine --external @temples/components --entry-naming "[name].[ext]" && bun build src/ssr.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target node --packages external --tsconfig-override tsconfig.build.json --external @temples/engine --external @temples/components --minify --entry-naming "[name].min.[ext]" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
